title: China Imposes Provisional Measures on Japanese Dichlorosilane: What Shin-Etsu Chemical's 99.2% Deposit Rate Means
excerpt: From September 8, 2026, China is applying provisional measures in the form of cash deposits to dichlorosilane from Japan. A beginner-friendly explanation of what Shin-Etsu Chemical's 99.2% rate means, how the material is used in semiconductor manufacturing, the financial burden at import, and what to watch next.
